title: Claude Code
before: AI coding lived in the editor as completions and chat. Devin and SWE-agent had shown the agent form a year earlier.
problem: Editor plugins cannot run tests, read a repository or iterate until something works.
breakthrough: An agent in the terminal with the repository, the shell and the test suite, working a task for many turns.
why: It made agentic coding a daily professional tool rather than a demo, and defined the terminal-agent form factor.
next: OpenAI's Codex agent, Gemini's Antigravity and the 2026 computer-using coding agents.
inherits: The coding agent as standard developer tooling.
